model_output.rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial on a commercial claim (CI). DOS 2025-01-19. The 277CA proves the payer received and accepted the claim on 2025-01-27 (8 days post-DOS) — timely under any commercial filing deadline. The 837P interchange date of 2025-10-15 suggests a resubmission, but the original acceptance report is dispositive proof. Appeal with the 277CA; do not write off.

root_cause.explanation: Payer denied CO-29 claiming filing limit expired. The 277CA shows claim accepted for processing (A2, status 20) on 2025-01-27 — 8 days after DOS. Original filing was timely; the denial is incorrect.

next_action.detail: Appeal CO-29 to Liberty Bell. Attach the 277CA showing receipt date 2025-01-27 (TRC75364521, status A2/20). Dispute the payer's receipt date — do not plead forgiveness. ERISA appeal deadline applies.

evidence.fact: Claim TRC75364521 received 2025-01-27, status A2 (accepted for adjudication), claim status 20 (accepted for processing)
Both lines denied CO-29 (timely filing expired), MOA N211; claim-level denial, $0 paid
